verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe provisioning a dedicated isolated SQLite database per user/agent, creating/token-scoping/tearing down via API, and spinning up 'thousands or millions' of isolated databases programmatically as core architecture, plus branch-per-PR automation and CLI/API creation flows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of actually managing a large fleet (thousands) at scale, and concrete cost data proving 'cheap' bulk provisioning.
